question: Who may execute a payment, and are scheduled or card payment rails authorized?
decision: At launch Union Eyes does not execute union-controlled member dues, disbursements, benefit payments, remittances or scheduled/card financial transactions. Authorized personnel may record externally executed union transactions with evidence. Distinguish these from platform commercial subscriptions and standalone paid ICRA/workbook purchases, which may use a separately approved hosted merchant checkout only after verified payment/webhook/refund/reconciliation controls; otherwise disable those checkouts too.
originalProposedDecision: At launch the platform executes no payments; payments are executed outside the app and recorded. No scheduled or card rails.
independentApprovalScope: decision wording / platform baseline only; NOT independent security or operational testing
